title: simple spyglasse's

body: Welcome to my resource pack! Most of the items in this pack are changed to spyglasses or various unique items related to the Unstable SMP(e.g. theo totem). Please note that the resource pack is still in active production and development, so not all textures have been changed yet. Stay tuned for future updates as more items and textures are added!
